read-model-support.purpose: Provide reusable read-model-support assets shared by identity-owned features and composition seams.
read-model-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
read-model-support.justification: read-model-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
read-model-support.createdFor: identity workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
read-model-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

ucp-support.purpose: Provide Identity-owned durable Linked Platform Authorization storage for UCP delegated access.
ucp-support.allowedWhen: Allowed because linked platform authorization spans OAuth token resolution, consent audit, and deployable protocol composition.
ucp-support.justification: Identity owns the durable user/account authorization fact while Auth owns the OAuth journey.
ucp-support.sunsetWhen: Move into a dedicated Identity feature slice when linked platform authorization gets UI management.
